title: Immersion Hours Toward Fluency
dataSources: Lessons (`lesson:complete`), vocab reviews (`vocab:review`), immersion (`immersion:log`), speaking practice (`speaking:session`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Duolingo / Babbel lesson exports, Anki spaced-repetition review logs, immersion trackers, and speaking-practice logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=immersion:log
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(minutes) as minutes by _time activity
| stats sum(minutes) as weekly by _time
| eval hours=round(weekly/60,1)
| sort - _time
description: Totals your weekly immersion hours — listening, watching, reading in the target language — toward a fluency estimate.
value: Comprehensible-input hours are the truest predictor of fluency; totalling them makes an abstract journey concrete.
implementation: Ingest immersion logs into `index=personal`; total weekly immersion hours.
visualization: Column chart of weekly immersion hours.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up your hours of listening and reading in the language, the real path to fluency.
